fact_sources.fact: The kind-0 expression has an exact simple-view witness and identical general/simple emitted code.
fact_sources.source: The existing transparent cm_rep_expr_kind, cm_simple_source_expr, cm_simple_expr, cm_expr_code_for and cm_simple_code_for definitions: destruct e using the kind guard, choose CMSimpleLeaf (CMLeafConst n ty), and unfold the corresponding constructor code equations (the same Z.eqb lvalue 0 choice on both sides).

vc_comparisons.reason: Both whole-VC disjuncts now have the same valid shape: kind 0 plus the emitter plan at entry pc/temp entails the simple-view plan. Constructor discrimination leaves exactly the CONST constructor, whose witness is CMSimpleLeaf (CMLeafConst n ty); source identity and classification follow by definition, while the two code lists reduce identically for arbitrary lvalue. The only new C premises follow reflexively from unchanged local stores, as confirmed by unchanged establishing goals. The old countermodel is excluded by those premises, not moved into another obligation. The C which-implies premise now carries pc == pc@pre and temp == temp@pre. In the generated whole VC those equalities substitute pc_pre/temp_pre for pc/temp and eliminate the independent current scalar binders; the original constructor-kind guard is unchanged. No ownership is added or removed. In the antecedent emitter plan, the general code arguments pc/temp are replaced by pc_pre/temp_pre under the added premise equalities; the existing done/tail and all emitter parameters are unchanged.
